issues: 相机推拉/平移是 4 段关键帧、每段各自 inOut，在 f14 与 f58 处速度归零，拉远过程一顿一顿
开场 2x 近景的旧页靠 transform 放大，文字发软；正文是一排灰色骨架条
GitHub 图标只是一个黑圆、Salesforce 是三团椭圆，瓷贴外一圈白色大光晕显得廉价
光管是粗彩带，输送脉冲是一串等长白色胶囊，读作圣诞灯串而不是能量流
背景霓虹框 2.5px 粗边且持续闪烁，和主角抢戏
changes: 推拉/平移合并成一条连续 bezier(0.55,0,0.18,1) 曲线（0→96f），前摇自然缓、全程无顿点；翻面 35f ease-out、侧棱 2f 闪、两拍接入时序全部保留
面板推拉改走 CSS zoom（布局级缩放），2.05x 近景与 1x 落定文字都原生栅格化；旧页换成出版级交易文档（字段行、摘要段落、待办）
瓷贴换渐变面 + 内高光 + 深投影，弹现带一次过冲（overshoot 13f），连通后才亮起暖色霓虹余光；GitHub 换分支字形、Salesforce 换平底云朵
光管收细为 12px 彩虹体 + 3px 白热芯，9f 生长期带一颗火花头；输送脉冲改为亮头 + 柔化拖尾的彗星形（速度 4.6px/f 不变），管口接入瞬间起一圈小涟漪
背景框去闪烁、1.5px 细边、轻微失焦并随相机做 18% 视差；加暗角与颗粒压住大面积暗场，并补导出 INTEGRATION_HUB_MAP_DURATION=150
issuesEn: The camera push/pan used four keyframe segments each with its own in-out, so velocity hit zero at f14 and f58 and the pull-back stuttered
The 2x opening close-up was transform-upscaled so text was soft, and the body copy was rows of grey skeleton bars
The GitHub icon was a plain black circle, Salesforce three blobby ellipses, and every tile had a cheap white halo
Pipes were thick color ribbons and the flow pulses were evenly spaced white capsules, reading as fairy lights rather than energy
Background neon frames had heavy 2.5px borders and flickered constantly, competing with the hero
changesEn: Push and pan merged into one continuous bezier(0.55,0,0.18,1) curve over 0→96f with a naturally slow pre-roll and no stalls; the 35f ease-out flip, 2f edge flash and two-beat connect timing are unchanged

The panel's zoom now uses CSS zoom (layout-level), so text rasterizes natively at both the 2.05x close-up and the 1x rest; the old page is a publication-grade deal document with fields, summary paragraphs and next steps

Tiles get a gradient face, inner highlight and deep shadow, pop in with one overshoot (13f), and only light up with a warm neon glow once connected; GitHub uses a branch glyph, Salesforce a flat-bottomed cloud

Pipes slimmed to a 12px rainbow body with a 3px white-hot core and a spark at the growing tip; flow pulses are comets with a bright head and soft tail (still 4.6px/f), plus a small ripple at each port on arrival
Background frames no longer flicker, use 1.5px edges with slight defocus and 18% camera parallax; vignette and grain hold the dark field; added INTEGRATION_HUB_MAP_DURATION=150
